titleEn: Shortest Subarray to be Removed to Make Array Sorted
title: 删除最短子数组使剩余数组有序
summary: 删除一个连续子数组，使剩余元素非递减，求删除长度最小值。
insight: 找到最长有序前缀和最长有序后缀。答案可删掉一整侧，也可用双指针寻找能拼接的前缀末尾与后缀开头。
pitfalls: 数组本来有序时返回零
删除区间可在数组边缘

solutions.title: 有序前后缀双指针拼接
solutions.idea: 枚举保留前缀结尾并推进可连接的后缀起点。
steps: 找 prefixEnd 与 suffixStart；若 prefixEnd==n-1 返回 0
i=0,j=suffixStart；若 arr[i]<=arr[j] 更新 j-i-1 并 i++，否则 j++

code.java: class Solution { public int findLengthOfShortestSubarray(int[] arr){int n=arr.length,left=0;while(left+1<n&&arr[left]<=arr[left+1])left++;if(left==n-1)return 0;int right=n-1;while(right>0&&arr[right-1]<=arr[right])right--;int answer=Math.min(n-left-1,right),i=0,j=right;while(i<=left&&j<n)if(arr[i]<=arr[j]){answer=Math.min(answer,j-i-1);i++;}else j++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findLengthOfShortestSubarray(arr:IntArray):Int{val n=arr.size;var left=0;while(left+1<n&&arr[left]<=arr[left+1])left++;if(left==n-1)return 0;var right=n-1;while(right>0&&arr[right-1]<=arr[right])right--;var answer=minOf(n-left-1,right);var i=0;var j=right;while(i<=left&&j<n)if(arr[i]<=arr[j]){answer=minOf(answer,j-i-1);i++}else j++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int findLengthOfShortestSubarray(vector<int>& arr){int n=arr.size(),left=0;while(left+1<n&&arr[left]<=arr[left+1])++left;if(left==n-1)return 0;int right=n-1;while(right&&arr[right-1]<=arr[right])--right;int answer=min(n-left-1,right),i=0,j=right;while(i<=left&&j<n)if(arr[i]<=arr[j]){answer=min(answer,j-i-1);++i;}else ++j;return answer;} };
